graph_path_policy: One deterministic shortest supporting path per scoped entity

score_semantics.dense: sqlite-vec L2 distance between normalized embeddings; lower is better
score_semantics.fusion: Weighted reciprocal-rank sum; higher is better; not confidence
score_semantics.lexical: SQLite FTS5 BM25; lower is better; not confidence
score_semantics.reranker: Raw cross-encoder score; higher is better; not confidence or comparable across queries, models, or historical BM25 scores; returned order is authoritative
